parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Token used to authenticate with the API. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_API_KEY environment variable.

parameters.name: binary_path
parameters.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

parameters.name: ca_cert
parameters.description: Path to a CA certificate used to authenticate with the API. The full certificate chain must be provided to avoid certificate validation errors. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_SSL_CA_CERT environment variable.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Helm option to specify which kubeconfig context to use. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable K8S_AUTH_CONTEXT will be used instead.

parameters.name: force_update
parameters.description: Whether or not to replace (overwrite) the repo if it already exists. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Provide a URL for accessing the API. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_HOST environment variable.

parameters.name: insecure_skip_tls_verify
parameters.description: Skip tls certificate checks for the repository url. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: kubeconfig
parameters.description: Helm option to specify kubeconfig path to use. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable K8S_AUTH_KUBECONFIG will be used instead. The configuration can be provided as dictionary.

parameters.name: pass_credentials
parameters.description: Pass credentials to all domains. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: repo_password
parameters.description: Chart repository password for repository with basic auth. Required if chart_repo_username is specified.

parameters.name: repo_username
parameters.description: Chart repository username for repository with basic auth. Required if chart_repo_password is specified.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to verify the API server’s SSL certificates. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_VERIFY_SSL environment variable. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Add a repository
  kubernetes.core.helm_repository:
    name: stable
    repo_url: https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx

- name: Add Red Hat Helm charts repository
  kubernetes.core.helm_repository:
    name: redhat-charts
    repo_url: https://redhat-developer.github.com/redhat-helm-charts

return_values.name: command
return_values.description: Full `helm` command built by this module, in case you want to re-run the command outside the module or debug a problem. Returned: always Sample: "/usr/local/bin/helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Error message returned by `helm` command Returned: on failure Sample: "Repository already have a repository named bitnami"

return_values.name: stderr
return_values.description: Full `helm` command stderr, in case you want to display it or examine the event log Returned: always Sample: ""

return_values.name: stderr_lines
return_values.description: Full `helm` command stderr in list, in case you want to display it or examine the event log Returned: always Sample: [""]

return_values.name: stdout
return_values.description: Full `helm` command stdout, in case you want to display it or examine the event log Returned: always Sample: "\"bitnami\" has been added to your repositories"

return_values.name: stdout_lines
return_values.description: Full `helm` command stdout in list, in case you want to display it or examine the event log Returned: always Sample: ["\"bitnami\" has been added to your repositories"]
